content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 13.2 (p0628) is a **deviation** from T4C. Ono's at-will exit is deferred until the later of two redacted periods after First Commercial Sale of each Product, leaving us with no convenience right for a multi-year stretch of a term that otherwise runs to expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term (13.1) — walk-away territory — and the notice period is redacted rather than fixed. No pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts is provided.

Array's side needs no change: Article 13 grants it only for-cause exits (13.3 material breach, 13.4 bankruptcy) plus the competing-product trigger in 8.2, so the "no Vendor convenience right" element is already met and I did not draft to it.

The single redline deletes the delayed commencement, fixes 30 days' written notice, and adds the pro-rata refund, while preserving the rationale requirement and all other termination and wind-down mechanics verbatim.
